build: Fire Blast / Wake of Fire Assassin leveling (Maxroll Season 16 Assassin Leveling Build Guide), from level 13 to the Lightning Sentry reset at 38
author: Teo1904 (Maxroll); levels 1-13 left out (Tristram runs, user 2026-11-22)

setup_legend.lvl 13-26 (Normal Act 2-5: Wake of Fire): Wake of Fire from 12 (2 traps + Fire Blast); Stealth at 17, Leaf at 19, the Act 2 merc from Act 4 Normal, Ancients' Pledge made in Act 5 and stashed, a Battle Staff of Teleportation from Ormus at 20-23 (worn on the swap from 24).
setup_legend.lvl 27-38 (Nightmare Act 1-3: Wake of Fi: Nightmare: Spirit sword + Ancients' Pledge, Lore, magic gloves/belt/boots from the Act 1 shop, a Wand of Lower Resistance at 30-35 (used from 36). Reset into Lightning Sentry at 38 (the Trapsin stage).
setup_legend.setups: 'setup' is the window a piece is worn in ('lvl a-b'); 'alternative' = the guide's Gear Options wearable by 38. Magic pieces are the guide's shop picks.

stat_source: Maxroll Season 16 guide text (skill points, gear checklist, Gear Options); item stats and required levels from blizzhackers/d2data (uniqueitems.json, setitems.json, runes.json + misc.json rune levels, magicprefix/suffix.json).

targets.skill_points: 1 per level from 2 plus the quests: Den of Evil +1, Radament +1, Izual +2 per difficulty. At 38: 37 levels + Normal 4 + Nightmare Den of Evil and Radament = 43.
targets.playstyle: Elite packs first: single monsters give far less experience. Lay 2 Wake of Fire traps as you run through an area and Fire Blast single targets and Act bosses; keep Burst of Speed up.

tips: Levels 1-13 by Tristram runs; then farm the Normal Countess (Black Marsh waypoint, Forgotten Tower) for Tal, Eth, Tir, Ral (+1-2 Ral for a gemmed helm) before Andariel.
Check Charsi for a 2-socket body armor and 2-socket helmets (not magic), Akara for a 2-socket Short Staff (Leaf), Farah for a belt and a 3-socket Large / Kite Shield (Ancients' Pledge).
Wake of Fire struggles in the Maggot Lair and Arcane Sanctuary: traps in the middle of narrow corridors, Fire Blast on the stairs.
Stealth at 17, Leaf at 19; be at least level 19-20 at the end of Act 3.
At 20-23 shop a Battle Staff of Teleportation from Ormus (only staves with a red background: level 24); re-enter Kurast Docks through a town portal to refresh his stock. Swap it on at 24.
Hire an Act 2 merc after entering Act 4, with a Pike from Halbu (Grand Vizier of Chaos, Colenzo on the first Baal wave).
Kill Izual for the skill points before Diablo; Act 5 quests 1 and 2: the socket reward and the Ancients' Pledge runes.
After Baal: the Secret Cow Level for a Crystal Sword / Broad Sword (Spirit base, Larzuk's socket reward), then the Baal waves to 26 before Nightmare.
Shop Heavy Gloves of Readiness, a Coral Belt of the Mammoth and Russet Heavy Boots of Haste (or similar: IAS, run speed, lightning and fire resistance first) at the start of Nightmare.
Farm the Nightmare Countess for Tal, Thul, 2 Ort, Amn, Sol: Spirit sword and Lore; more Ort to recharge the staff and wand.
At 30-35 shop a Wand of Lower Resistance from Akara or Drognan (red-background wands); use Lower Resist on Act bosses from 36.
Reset into Lightning Sentry at 38, before Act 4 Nightmare (the Trapsin stage).
